summary: explain's field strand narrates the log's absence against the lock's declared telemetry wiring (0046) instead of returning silence when a roster requirement declares a telemetry verifier.

edit.description: `field()`'s absent/empty-log branch (27-30) unconditionally returns `String::new()`. Thread in a declared-wiring signal (a new parameter) so an absent/empty log narrates the absence — the declared wiring against the empty log, evidence never verdict, per 0046 — only when the lock actually declares tap registrations; a roster with no telemetry verifier stays silent exactly as today.

`explain`'s `Species::Member` branch (308, `telemetry::field(...)` call) computes whether `roster` (built at 1709-1713 from `declarations.requirements`) holds any `Requirement` whose `verifier` is `Some(compose::Verifier::Telemetry { .. })`, and threads that into the `telemetry::field` call — the same roster corpus `roster::admissibility` already reads for a telemetry verifier's event names (READ-EDGE-UNIFY).

`an_absent_log_narrates_no_field_strand_and_explain_still_reads` (505-518, empty roster) must stay green unchanged. Add a case: a roster requirement declaring `Verifier::Telemetry` over an absent/empty tap log narrates the declared-vs-empty absence rather than staying silent.

tests.asserts: a member target with a roster requirement declaring a telemetry verifier, over an absent/empty tap log, narrates the absence against the declared wiring instead of staying silent

acceptance: `temper explain <member>` states the tap's absence-against-declaration when a roster requirement's telemetry verifier names an event and the tap log carries no matching records — evidence, not a verdict, never a gate — while a harness with no telemetry verifier declared still narrates nothing over an absent log.
notes: 0046 Consequences: pipeline.md's Telemetry already carries the absence clause and the (advisory-report-channel) fork is already gone from open-questions.md, both shipped in 53e6f615 itself — verified on disk, nothing to re-route for those two. Only the engine narration is undone: telemetry::field's absent-log branch (src/telemetry.rs:27-30) still returns String::new() unconditionally regardless of what the roster (src/read.rs:1709-1713) declares. scoped at 53e6f615.
